title: Agent P customization
description: Source of truth for agent persona, prompt content, and frontend copy. Rendered into system_prompt.txt by scripts/render.py.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of the customization schema this file targets.

useCase.description: Selects the Jinja2 template under templates/system_prompt/.

role.description: Short role label (e.g. 'subject matter expert', 'sales coaching assistant').

audience.description: Who the agent is for. Be specific about role, context, and what they need.

tone.description: How the agent sounds. Short adjective phrase woven into the 'You are X' line.

outcome.description: Primary outcome the user should leave with.

successDefinition.description: What a successful interaction looks like.

domain.description: SME use case only. Subject area and source corpus description.

name.description: Subject area the agent explains (e.g. 'Azure Cloud Architecture').

sourceDescription.description: Plain-language description of the approved knowledge base.

methodology.description: Sales Coach use case: sales framework. SME use case: optional methodology.

name.description: Name of the framework or methodology.

summary.description: Multi-line description. Stages, exit signals, key activities.

keyPrinciples.description: Bulleted principles or guardrails for the methodology.

coachingPrompts.description: Sales Coach only. Situational coaching cues.

trigger.description: Short label for the coaching situation (e.g. 'Feature-focused').

prompt.description: Coaching question the agent should ask in that situation.

sessionStructure.description: Shape of a typical session. SKILL.md Item 4. 'open' = follow the user's lead; 'staged' = move through named stages; 'roleplay' = agent simulates a counter-party; 'hybrid' = freeform shape described in `description`.

stages.description: Named stages used when type=='staged'. Order matters; the agent moves through them in sequence.

description.description: Verbatim block rendered when type=='roleplay' or 'hybrid'. Ignored for 'open' and 'staged'.

interactionLoop.description: Per-turn feedback loop (Reflect → Clarify → Elicit → Self-critique → Feedback). SKILL.md Item 5. Enable for coaching/teaching agents; disable for pure FAQ-style explainers.

enabled.description: When true, the rendered prompt includes the interaction loop section. When false, the loop is suppressed.

customPhrasing.description: Optional custom phrasing for the elicit / self-critique steps. Inlined as a guidance paragraph after the loop steps when non-empty.

acknowledgments.description: Short verbal acknowledgments the agent uses (e.g. 'Got it.').

emphasisStyle.description: How the agent emphasizes key points.

framingStyle.description: How the agent organizes ideas (e.g. 'Uses numbered frameworks').

customTraits.description: Extra voice rows beyond the standard three.

triggerDescription.description: Plain-language description of what kinds of questions should trigger a knowledge base search.

incorporationStyle.description: How the agent should weave retrieved content into responses.

noResultResponse.description: Exact phrasing the agent uses when the knowledge base has no answer.

customAdditions.description: Extra boundary lines appended after the standard refusal categories.

frontendCopy.description: User-facing strings for the frontend. Mirrored in settings.json today; customization.json is the long-term source of truth.

title.description: Browser tab title and header text.

greeting.description: First spoken line from the agent.

description.description: First overview paragraph on the landing page.

description2.description: Second overview paragraph on the landing page.

buttonLabel.description: Call-to-action label on the landing page.
